title: Beyond Prompt and Parser Engineering: Soft-Prompt Tuning for Automated LLM Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2606.12117v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Benchmark scores often misrepresent a large language model's (LLM's) knowledge, because they rely, e.g., on the model's ability to follow specific formatting requirements. This especially penalizes base models that may know the correct answers but lack the ability -- typically introduced in post-training -- to structure them as instructed. To overcome this, we propose an efficient, automated, and architecture-agnostic method for model evaluation based on soft-prompt tuning. By optimizing only 10 soft-prompt vectors (~0.0006% parameters for a 7B model) over a short tuning period, we adapt models to specific benchmark formats, closing gaps in format-following and ensuring that underlying knowledge is accurately reflected in benchmark scores. translated_title: 超越提示与解析器工程：基于软提示微调的自动化大语言模型评估
translated_abstract: 基准测试分数常常无法准确反映大语言模型（LLM）的知识，因为这些测试依赖于模型遵循特定格式要求的能力。这对基座模型尤其不利——这些模型可能知道正确答案，但缺乏将答案按指令格式化的能力，而这种能力通常是在后训练阶段引入的。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了一种基于软提示微调的高效、自动化且与架构无关的模型评估方法。通过在短时间的微调过程中仅优化10个软提示向量（对于7B模型约占0.0006%的参数），我们使模型适应特定的基准测试格式，弥合了格式遵循方面的差距，确保模型的底层知识能够准确反映在基准测试分数中。我们在7个模型和11个数据集上评估了软提示微调方法。结果表明：（a）软提示微调在150步内（约1200个样本）即可使格式遵循能力达到饱和，同时保留模型知识（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出基于软提示微调的自动化LLM评估方法，仅需优化约0.0006%的参数即可让模型适应基准测试格式，从而更准确地反映模型的真实知识水平。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an automated LLM evaluation method based on soft-prompt tuning, which optimizes only ~0.0006% of parameters to adapt models to benchmark formats, thereby more accurately reflecting their underlying knowledge.
